title: 2024 Topps Series 1 #49 J.P. Crawford Seattle Mariners Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This J.P. Crawford baseball trading card is a must-have for any fan of the Seattle Mariners or Major League Baseball (MLB). The card features Crawford in his 2024 Topps Series 1 base set and is a great addition to any sports trading card collection. With the card number 49, it is sure to be a sought-after item for collectors. 

The card is manufactured by Topps and is in excellent condition, ready to be added to your collection. Whether you are a seasoned collector or just starting out, this J.P. Crawford trading card is a great choice. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own a piece of baseball history.
